# Audit the original hand-tuned PI; it was not synthesized by hinfsyn
Kp,Ki=5.,2.;C_pi=ctrl.tf([Kp,Ki],[1,0]);G_nom=ctrl.tf([1],[1,.2,1])
L=G_nom*C_pi;CL=ctrl.feedback(L);poles=ctrl.poles(CL)
alpha=float(max(poles.real));stable=alpha<0
print('original PI poles=',poles,'max real=',alpha,'stable=',stable)
print('Routh: 0.2*(1+5)=1.2 < 1*2=2, so nominal PI is unstable')
assert not stable
omega=np.logspace(-2,2,1000);Lj=L(1j*omega);S=1/(1+Lj);T=Lj/(1+Lj)
print('finite frequency sample max |S|=',max(abs(S)),'; not a stable H-infinity norm')
print('overshoot, settling time, stable final value: undefined for this unstable loop')
t_sim=np.linspace(0,30,2000);_,y=ctrl.step_response(CL,t_sim)
_,u=ctrl.step_response(ctrl.feedback(C_pi,G_nom),t_sim)
print('finite-window max |u|=',max(abs(u)),'actuator target<=10:',max(abs(u))<=10)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10,3.7));ax[0].semilogx(omega,abs(S),label='formal |S|');ax[0].semilogx(omega,abs(T),label='formal |T|');ax[0].legend();ax[0].set(xlabel='rad/s',ylabel='magnitude')
ax[1].plot(t_sim,y,label='unstable output');ax[1].plot(t_sim,u,label='unsaturated control');ax[1].legend();ax[1].set(xlabel='time (s)',ylabel='finite-window response');plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('pi_audit_complete')

# Preserve the original 500-sample purpose, classify stability before metrics
N_mc=500;rng=np.random.default_rng(42)
delta_m_samples=rng.uniform(-1,1,N_mc);delta_k_samples=rng.uniform(-1,1,N_mc)
alphas=[];sample_peaks=[]
for dm,dk in zip(delta_m_samples,delta_k_samples):
    m=1+.3*dm;k=1+.3*dk
    alphas.append(float(max(np.roots([m,.2,k+Kp,Ki]).real)))
    z=1j*omega;Li=(Kp*z+Ki)/(z*(m*z*z+.2*z+k))
    sample_peaks.append(float(max(abs(1/(1+Li)))))
alphas=np.array(alphas);sample_peaks=np.array(sample_peaks)
print('seed=42; samples=500; unstable=',sum(alphas>=0),'alpha range=',min(alphas),max(alphas))
print('whole square: .2*(k+5)<=1.26 < m*2>=1.4, hence every allowed PI loop unstable')
print('No overshoot/settling histograms: these metrics require a stable final value')
assert np.all(alphas>0)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10,3.7));ax[0].hist(alphas,bins=25);ax[0].set(xlabel='rightmost pole real part (1/s)',ylabel='count')
sc=ax[1].scatter(delta_m_samples,delta_k_samples,c=alphas,s=10);fig.colorbar(sc,ax=ax[1]);ax[1].set(xlabel='delta_m',ylabel='delta_k');plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('sampling_audit_complete')

# A permitted corner versus the sample maximum is not full-block conservatism
omega_plot=np.logspace(-2,2,500)
idx=int(np.argmax(sample_peaks));dm_sample=float(delta_m_samples[idx]);dk_sample=float(delta_k_samples[idx])
print('sample maximizer of formal finite-grid |S|:',dm_sample,dk_sample)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,3.7))
for name,dm,dk in [('nominal',0,0),('allowed corner',1,-1),('sample maximizer',dm_sample,dk_sample)]:
    z=1j*omega_plot;Li=(Kp*z+Ki)/(z*((1+.3*dm)*z*z+.2*z+1+.3*dk));Si=1/(1+Li)
    print(name,'formal frequency-grid maximum=',max(abs(Si)))
    ax.semilogx(omega_plot,abs(Si),label=name)
ax.set(xlabel='rad/s',ylabel='formal |S| (unstable loop)');ax.legend();ax.grid();plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('No H-infinity-versus-mu ranking, no conservatism percentage, no robust-performance certificate')
print('comparison_audit_complete')
